name: HZ_HIERARCHY_NODES
description: The HZ_HIERARCHY_NODES table contains denormalized data for hierarchical relationships.

columns.name: HIERARCHY_NODE_ID
columns.description: Unique hierarchy node identifier.

columns.name: HIERARCHY_TYPE
columns.description: The hierarchy type name

columns.name: PARENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the parent in this hierarchical relationship

columns.name: PARENT_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the source table for the parent

columns.name: PARENT_OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: Object type of the parent

columns.name: CHILD_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the child in this hierarchical relationship

columns.name: CHILD_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the source table for the child

columns.name: CHILD_OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: Object type of the child

columns.name: LEVEL_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of relationship levels between the parent and the child

columns.name: TOP_PARENT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the parent is a root node. Y if the parent in the relationship is at the root node, N if the parent is not at the root node

columns.name: LEAF_CHILD_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the child is leaf node. Y if the child in the relationship has no children, N if the child has children

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Indicates if this hierarchical relationship is active or inactive

columns.name: RELATIONSHIP_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a hierarchical relationship

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ACTUAL_CONTENT_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of data content

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).
